description: Texts of the game and the extensions, as the game shows them, references resolved: {page, id} in a language; the texts of a page; or the texts that contain some words. Use it instead of searching the t folders: for what a {page, id} says, or to find an existing text to reuse.

id.description: The text id on the page; without it, the texts of the page.

language.description: The language number, 44 for English; by default the one the server was started with.

limit.description: The most texts to return for a page or a search; 20 by default.

search.description: Instead of page and id: words that must all be in the text, without regard to case.

name: text
title: Look up texts
